newsitem.title: USA: Star Louisiana heavy oil unit seen back next week.
newsitem.headline: Star Louisiana heavy oil unit seen back next week.

text.p: Star Enterprises said Tuesday it plans sometime next week to restart a 40,000 barrel per day "H-oil" unit downed Dec 4 during a fire at the company's refinery in Convent, Louisiana.
"I'm guessing about a week longer it will be back on line, although it might not be fully operational right away," said Joby Humphrey, a spokeswoman for the company.
Humphrey said the H-oil unit -- short for heavy oil unit -- is used to convert heavy residual fuel into more valuable lighter ends such as gasoline and diesel fuel.
"It was not very badly damaged" in the fire, she added, and has undergone partial repairs.
The refinery has a crude distillation capacity of 225,000 barrels per day. Star is a 50-50 joint venture between Texaco and state-owned Saudi Aramco.
